title: CCI approves acquisition of 100% of the issued share capital of Solenergi Power (Target) by Aditya Birla Renewables Ltd (Acquirer)
body_text: The Competition Commission of India (CCI) has approved the acquisition of 100% of the issued share capital of Solenergi Power Private Limited (Target) by Aditya Birla Renewables Limited (Acquirer). The proposed combination relates to acquisition of 100% of the issued share capital of the Target by the Acquirer from Shell Overseas Investment B.V. ( Seller ). The Acquirer (including its subsidiaries) is engaged in the business of power generation through renewable energy resources (solar and wind) as well as captive Engineering, Procurement and Construction ( EPC ) activities. The Target is primarily a holding company, registered in Mauritius. It does not have any other businesses except that of a holding company. The Target is present in India through: (i) certain downstream holding entities; and (ii) entities that are engaged in the business of power generation through renewable energy resources (solar and wind). ***** KT/ONP
